overall_summary: Data volume is extremely low (6 videos, 5-20 views each). While digital memory triggers (saved contact names/photos) show slightly higher initial impressions, overall confidence remains low and calls for controlled exploration.

winning_patterns.evidence: Video A_eLARoegnw (20 views) and a9-G1X5jEOU (15 views) led performance by grounding emotion in specific phone UI interactions.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on subtle, everyday smartphone interaction triggers rather than abstract sadness.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic atmosphere hooks without specific conflict
weak_patterns.evidence: Video uIbMpCjVutQ ('मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई') garnered only 5 views due to passive setting without emotional stakes.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid passive atmospheric openers; start with an immediate physical action or micro-realization.
